spans.s: SV0018 अध्यशन adhyaśana Taking food over and again the previous meal (before it digested) which may end up with metabolic disorders.
AF0109 अध्यस्थि adhyasthi Hypertrophy of bone

SV0017 अध्यात्मिक कर्म adhyātmika karma Different virtuous activities like scarifying etc are included here. Bhagavat gita a holy book of Hindu describes that type of karma as act of scarify, gift and austerity or penance should not be relinquished but should be performed. Scarify gift and austerity purifies the intelligence.
BP0006 आध्यात्मिकः (तापः) ādhyātmikaḥ (tāpaḥ) One of the three kinds of miseries, being that which is intrinsic and consist of mental and spiritual ailing.
